title: Overview
pageDescription: How the space is doing this month: revenue, expenses, occupancy, and what is coming next.

ai.profitUpOccDownTitle: You're {{percent}}% up on net profit — but occupancy slipped.
ai.profitUpOccDownBody: Occupancy is down {{points}} pts vs last month. Higher-priced plans are carrying revenue; consider opening a Flex slot to lock in the empty days.
ai.profitUpTitle: Net profit is up {{percent}}% vs last month.
ai.profitUpBody: Healthy {{month}}. Revenue {{verb}}, expenses stayed in check. Worth a quick look at next month's pipeline so the momentum carries.
ai.profitDownTitle: Net profit is down {{percent}}% vs last month.
ai.profitDownBody: Revenue trailed off and the gap matters. Look at empty days and whether any contract ended without a renewal.
ai.occDownTitle: Occupancy slipped {{points}} pts vs last month.
ai.occDownBody: Even with profit flat, empty desks are leaving money on the table. A Flex slot at fair price often pulls the rate back up.
ai.steadyBody: Net profit of {{net}} with occupancy at {{occ}}%. No fires — good time to plan next month's pipeline.
ai.inRedBody: Net profit is {{net}}. Trim a recurring expense, fill a desk, or both.
ai.startedBodyNoDesk: No desk-days booked yet this month. Open the calendar to see what's free and start filling the week.
ai.startedBodyWithDesk: Net profit of {{net}} on {{occ}}% occupancy. As more months roll in, this card will start comparing — so trends become visible at a glance.
